question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The incorrectly spelt word is '**Repitetion**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Repitetion**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Repetition**'. • It means 'doing something again; something that you do or that happens again'. (पुनरावृति; दोहराई हुई वस्‍तु) • *Example: to learn by **repetition**...*** Correct Answer:__** *Repitetion.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Portray**: to show somebody/something in a picture; to describe somebody/something in a piece of writing. (किसी को चित्र में दर्शाना; किसी का लेख में वर्णन या चित्रण करना) • **Procedure**: the usual or correct way for doing something. (कुछ करने का सामान्‍य या सही ढंग; प्रक्रिया) • **Separate**: apart; not together. (अलग, पृथक; न जुड़ा हुआ) 3c:T5fa, The correct answer is** 'Is Savita joining us for lunch today?'.**
